name: Pangu
title: The First Being
summary: Balances Yin and Yang to empower his abilities and crush enemies, especially in the early game.
lore: A primordial being older even than Tian’s other gods, Pangu shaped much of reality, and his body itself forms many of the realm’s earth and mountains. Since the Shattering, a portion of him has awakened and manifested, providing aid and advice to gods of Order. Should he awaken in his entirety, the results to Tian could be nothing short of apocalyptic.
archetype_description: Increase all stats by 0.5% for each piece of chain armor attuned

awakening_bonuses.description: Also, Increase ACC by 1% when FTH is more than SPD and increase ATK by 1% when SPD is more than FTH.
If this hero has more FTH than SPD, place [ATK Down II] otherwise place a random Lock on each target for 2 turns.
Also Increase this hero’s HP by 10% (stacking up to 5 times).

awakening_bonuses.description: Also, Increase ACC by 1% when FTH is more than SPD and increase ATK by 1% when SPD is more than FTH.

skills.name: Heaven and Earth
skills.description:
Place [ACC Up II] on this hero for 2 turns then attack all enemies 10%HP+110%ATK.

If this hero has more FTH than SPD, place [DEF Down II] on each target for 2 turns and increase this hero’s SPD by 50. Otherwise, place [FTH Down II] on each target hit for 2 turns and decrease this hero’s SPD by 50.
